Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 A DevOps specialist’s daily activities involve managing CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure deployment, and ensuring system reliability through monitoring and logging. They collaborate with developers to streamline code integration and troubleshoot deployment issues while optimizing performance. Security and compliance are key aspects, requiring regular updates, patching, and access control management. Additionally, they work with containerization, cloud platforms, and scripting to maintain scalable, efficient, and resilient infrastructure.
 What You’ll Do
Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and automated cloud infrastructure using AWS, Terraform, and Terragrunt 
Oversee the management and optimization of Kubernetes clusters, ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence 
Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD to streamline deployment processes and support GitOps methodologies 
Oversee automation initiatives using Golang and Bash to improve infrastructure reliability and efficiency 
Implement and maintain observability solutions leveraging Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo to ensure proactive monitoring and performance optimization 
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering teams to align infrastructure strategies with business goals and technology advancements 
 Who You Are
Strong hands-on expertise with AWS cloud services 
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, particularly Terraform and Terragrunt 
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes administration, operations, and optimisation 
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD 
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Golang and Bash 
Experience with observability and monitoring platforms including Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo.Knowledge of containerisation technologies and cloud-native architectures 
Understanding of security best practices, compliance requirements, patch management, and access controls 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
 Hybrid way of working: 2 days per week/ 8 per month- Medical and dental services
 Life and hospitalization insurance- Dedicated employee phone subscription
 Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget 
 Special discounts for gyms and retailers
 Annual Company Bonus
 Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
 You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
 We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off
 Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
 Advanced cloud infrastructure design and optimisation on AWS.
Large-scale Kubernetes operations and platform engineering practices.
GitOps deployment methodologies and CI/CD optimisation techniques.
Enhanced observability, monitoring, and performance management capabilities.
Infrastructure automation using Golang, Bash, Terraform, and Terragrunt.Security, compliance, and resilience best practices within cloud environments.
